The simulator builds cleanly with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` exactly as required.

## Summary

I implemented an RS274/NGC G-code simulator in C++20 in `/workspace/output/`:

- **`output/CMakeLists.txt`** — CMake build config (C++20, std lib only)
- **`output/src/main.cpp`** — ~3375 lines, single-file implementation

The simulator handles:
- **Parser**: full RS274 line grammar including expressions, parameters, unary ops (atan, sin, cos, sqrt etc.), comments, MSG messages
- **All G-codes**: G0–G3 (motion, arcs), G4 (dwell), G10 (coord set), G17/18/19 (planes), G20/G21 (units), G28/G30 (home), G38.2 (probe), G40/41/42 (CRC state), G43/G49 (TLO), G53 (machine coords), G54–G59.3 (coord systems), G61/G64 (path mode), G80–G89 (all canned cycles), G90/G91 (distance), G92/G92.1/2/3, G93/G94 (feed mode), G98/G99 (return)
- **All M-codes**: M0/1/2/30/60 (stops), M3/4/5 (spindle), M6 (tool change), M7/8/9 (coolant), M48/49 (overrides)
- **Canned cycle expansion** into sub-motions with proper preliminary motion, sticky values, L repeats
- **M2/M30 program-end reset** per spec section 3.6.1
- **Tool table** parsing (RS274 format)
- **Parameter file** input/output with default 5220 handling
- **Probe-box / probe-tool** for G38.2 trip simulation
- **Trace output** with all three stepping modes (time, distance, position-tolerance) and proper delta encoding, motion_kind labels on canned cycles, nonmodal_g_codes labels
- **Error handling** with `error_line_number` and `error_block_segment_index` (segment index for multi-sub-motion errors)
- **Percent-delimited** files
- **Block delete** switch

Verified against all three examples from the prompt (simple G1, G81 canned cycle, error case) plus additional tests for G92, helical arcs, expressions, probe with box, parameter I/O, and the full canned cycle test program from Appendix C of the spec.
